title: RaidIndex
wikitext:
Each member in a raid group is assigned a numeric index value between 1 and [[API MAX RAID MEMBERS|MAX_RAID_MEMBERS]] called their '''RaidIndex'''.

RaidIndex values are used when referring to a raid member with the raidN [[API Type UnitId|UnitId]] and when querying raid roster information with the [[API GetRaidRosterInfo|GetRaidRosterInfo]] function.
